question: During the first year, the population of a town increased by 10%s and during the next year the population decreased by 10%. If the total population of the town was 19,800 at the end of the second year. find the population size at the beginning of the first year.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change for successive increase and decrease of R% = −(R²/100)%.

Net change = −(10²/100)% = −1% (decrease).

Initial population × 99% = 19,800

Initial population = 19,800 ÷ 0.99 = 20,000.

**∴ The correct answer is 20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Population increase in 1st year = 10%

Population decrease in 2ⁿd year = 10%

Final population after 2 years = 19,800
